info.title: Recoup API - Content
info.description: API documentation for the Recoup platform - an AI agent platform for the music industry

get.description: List all sandboxes associated with the authenticated account and their current statuses. Returns sandbox details including lifecycle state, timeout remaining, and creation timestamp. Pass account_id to retrieve sandboxes for a specific account the API key has access to. Authentication is handled via the x-api-key header or Authorization Bearer token.

parameters.name: sandbox_id
parameters.description: Filter by a specific sandbox ID. When provided, returns only the sandbox matching this ID. Must be a sandbox that your account or organization is an admin of.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Filter to a specific account. Only applicable when the authenticated account has access to multiple accounts via organization membership.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - account_id is not a member of the organization or account tried to filter by an account_id they don't have access to

post.description: Create a new ephemeral sandbox environment. Optionally executes a command or an OpenCode prompt if provided. Sandboxes are isolated Linux microVMs that can be used to evaluate account-generated code, run AI agent output safely, or execute reproducible tasks. The sandbox will automatically stop after the timeout period. If no command or prompt is provided, the sandbox is created without triggering any background task. Use the prompt parameter as a shortcut to run `opencode run "<prompt>"` in the sandbox. Pass account_id to create a sandbox for a specific account the API key has access to. Authentication is handled via the x-api-key header or Authorization Bearer token.

requestBody.description: Optional command execution parameters. If command and prompt are both omitted, sandbox is created without running any command. Use prompt as a shortcut for running OpenCode.

400.description: Bad request - failed to create sandbox

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - account_id is not a member of the organization or account tried to use an account_id they don't have access to

patch.description: Set a custom snapshot ID for an account. By default, updates the key owner's account. Pass account_id to target a specific account the API key has access to. This allows accounts to use a specific sandbox snapshot when creating new sandboxes, enabling reproducible environments with pre-configured tools, dependencies, and files.

400.description: Bad request - invalid snapshot ID

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - account_id is not a member of the organization or account tried to use an account_id they don't have access to

delete.description: Delete a sandbox environment for the authenticated account. This permanently deletes the associated GitHub repository and removes the account's snapshot record from the database. By default, deletes the sandbox for the key owner's account. Pass account_id to target a specific account the API key has access to. Authentication is handled via the x-api-key header or Authorization Bearer token.

400.description: Bad request - failed to delete sandbox

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - account_id is not a member of the organization or account tried to use an account_id they don't have access to

post.description: Triggers the setup-sandbox background task to create a personal sandbox, provision a GitHub repo, take a snapshot, and shut down. By default, sets up the sandbox for the key owner's account. Pass account_id to target a specific account the API key has access to. Authentication is handled via the x-api-key header or Authorization Bearer token.

400.description: Bad request - invalid account_id format

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

get.description: Retrieve the contents of a file from the authenticated account's sandbox GitHub repository. Resolves the github_repo from the [account's snapshot](/api-reference/sandboxes/list), then fetches the file at the specified path from the repository's main branch. **Text files are returned verbatim. Binary files (`.mp3`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.mp4`, `.pdf`, etc.) are returned base64-encoded — decode before writing to disk.** Authentication is handled via the x-api-key header or Authorization Bearer token.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file path within the repository (e.g. "src/index.ts" or "README.md").

400.description: Bad request - missing or invalid path parameter

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - account does not have access

404.description: Not found - no snapshot, no github_repo, or file not found in repository

post.description: Issue a presigned upload token so the browser can upload a file directly to Vercel Blob, then call `POST /api/sandboxes/files` with the resulting blob URL to commit it to the sandbox repo. Use `upload()` from `@vercel/blob/client` rather than calling this route by hand. Max file size 100MB.

200.description: Handshake response from `@vercel/blob/client` — return verbatim to the library.

401.description: Missing or invalid auth on the handshake POST.

500.description: Invalid body or upstream Vercel Blob failure.

post.description: Upload one or more files to the authenticated account's sandbox GitHub repository. Accepts an array of file URLs and commits each file to the specified directory path within the repository. Supports submodule resolution — if the target path falls within a git submodule, the file is committed to the submodule's repository. Authentication is handled via the x-api-key header or Authorization Bearer token.

requestBody.description: JSON body containing file URLs and target path

400.description: Bad request - missing files or invalid path

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - account does not have access

404.description: Not found - no snapshot or no github_repo configured

get.description: Generate high-quality images using AI models. Images are automatically stored on Arweave and include In Process moment metadata for provenance and ownership tracking.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Text description of the image you want to generate

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the account generating the image

400.description: Bad request - missing required parameters or invalid input

post.description: Transcribe audio files using OpenAI Whisper. The API saves both the original audio file and the generated markdown transcript to the customer's files in Supabase Storage. The owner account is derived from your credentials; you must have access to the specified artist_account_id.

400.description: Bad request - missing required fields or invalid audio URL

401.description: Missing or invalid credentials

403.description: Caller has no access to the specified artist_account_id

500.description: Server error - OpenAI API key not configured

patch.description: Apply ffmpeg edits to a video — trim, crop, resize, or overlay text. Pass a `template` for a preset edit pipeline, or build your own with an `operations` array.

202.description: Edit task triggered successfully. Poll via [GET /api/tasks/runs](/api-reference/tasks/runs) using the returned `runId`.

400.description: Validation failed — invalid or missing request body fields

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

post.description: Trigger the content creation pipeline for an artist. Provide `artist_account_id` to identify the target artist. Validates the artist has all required files (face guide, songs) unless overridden via `songs` URLs or `images`, then triggers a background task that generates a short-form video. Returns `runIds` — an array of run IDs that can each be polled via [GET /api/tasks/runs](/api-reference/tasks/runs).

requestBody.description: Content creation parameters including the target artist and optional template/workflow settings

202.description: Pipeline triggered successfully. Returns `runIds` — an array of run IDs. Poll each via [GET /api/tasks/runs](/api-reference/tasks/runs) to check progress.

400.description: Validation failed — missing artist identifier, artist is missing required files, or template not found

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

404.description: Artist not found — the provided artist_account_id does not match any artist

get.description: List all available content creation templates. Templates are optional — every content primitive works without one. When you do use a template, it provides a complete creative recipe: image prompts, video motion config, caption style rules, and edit operations. Returns template ID and description only — enough to pick the right one.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

get.description: Get the full configuration for a specific content creation template. Returns the complete creative recipe including image prompts, video motion config, caption style rules, and edit operations.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

get.description: Check whether an artist has all the required files to run the content creation pipeline. Returns a structured report of each required and recommended file with its status. Required files must be present or the pipeline will fail. Recommended files improve output quality but are not strictly necessary. Provide `artist_account_id` as a query parameter.

parameters.name: artist_account_id
parameters.description: UUID of the artist account to validate. Use [GET /api/artists](/api-reference/artists/list) to find artist account IDs.

200.description: Validation completed. Check the `ready` field to determine if the artist can run the pipeline.

400.description: Bad request — artist_account_id is required

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

404.description: Artist not found — the provided artist_account_id does not match any artist

get.description: Estimate the cost of running the content creation pipeline. Calculates per-step and per-video costs based on current pricing. Supports comparing multiple workflow profiles (e.g., premium vs. budget) and projecting batch costs. This endpoint is informational only — it does not trigger any pipeline execution or spend credits.

parameters.name: lipsync
parameters.description: Which workflow to estimate. `false` for image-to-video, `true` for audio-to-video. If omitted, estimates the default image-to-video workflow.

parameters.name: batch
parameters.description: Number of videos to project costs for. Use this to answer questions like "how much would 30 videos cost?"

parameters.name: compare
parameters.description: When `true`, returns estimates for all available workflow profiles (premium, budget, mid) for side-by-side comparison.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

post.description:
Webhook endpoint for the Recoup Content Agent Slack bot. Receives @mention events from Slack and triggers content generation for the mentioned artist. The bot parses the mention text for `<artist_account_id> [template] [batch=N] [lipsync]`, validates the artist, calls POST /api/content/create, and starts a background polling task that reports results back to the Slack thread.

For Slack, also handles `url_verification` challenges during app setup.

requestBody.description: Slack Events API payload (app_mention event or url_verification challenge)

schema.description: Slack Events API envelope — the shape depends on the event type

post.description:
Internal callback endpoint for the `poll-content-run` Trigger.dev task. Receives content generation results and posts them back to the originating Slack thread. Authenticated via the `x-callback-secret` header.

This endpoint is not intended for external use — it is called automatically by the polling task when content runs complete, fail, or time out.

requestBody.description: Content generation results from the polling task

threadId.description: Chat SDK thread identifier for the originating Slack thread

status.description: Overall status of the content generation batch

videoUrl.description: URL of the generated video (when completed)

200.description: Callback processed and results posted to Slack

400.description: Invalid request body

401.description: Missing or invalid callback secret

post.description: Transcribe audio into text with word-level timestamps. Pass one or more audio file URLs in `audio_urls`. Returns the full transcript and an array of timed segments.

400.description: Validation failed — invalid or missing request body fields

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

post.description: Start a song generation with MiniMax Music 3. Generation runs in the background and takes roughly one to two minutes, so this returns **202** immediately with a `pending` generation. Poll [Get Music Generation](/api-reference/music/get) until `status` is `completed` or `failed`; `audio_url` is populated on completion. Credits are checked before the model is called and deducted only when a generation completes, so a failed generation is never charged.

400.description: Validation failed. `missing_fields` names the first offending field.

401.description: Unauthorized. Provide exactly one of `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer`.

402.description: Insufficient credits. No generation is created and the model is not called.

403.description: Access denied to the specified `account_id` or `organization_id`.

get.description: The calling account's music generations, newest first. Scope follows the standard account override: with no `account_id` you get your own personal and organization generations; pass `account_id` to read another account you can access.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Optional. Read another account you can access. Defaults to the calling account.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional. Return only generations in this state.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. Maximum generations to return, newest first.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Optional. Number of generations to skip, for paging.

200.description: Generations in the requested context, newest first.

400.description: Invalid query parameter.

401.description: Unauthorized.

get.description: One generation, including the `seed` the model used and its `logs` progress, both read live from the provider rather than stored. This is the polling target while a generation is in flight: call it until `status` is `completed` or `failed`. Responses are never cached.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Optional. Read on behalf of another account you can access.

200.description: The generation, with the seed it used and its render progress.

400.description: `generationId` is not a valid uuid.

401.description: Unauthorized.

403.description: Access denied to this generation's account.

post.description: Generate a song from a text prompt or a composition plan. The prompt can describe mood, genre, instruments, lyrics, and structure. Alternatively, pass a full composition_plan for fine-grained control over sections, styles, and lyrics. Returns binary audio in the requested format (default MP3).

song-id.description: Unique identifier for the generated song

400.description: Validation failed — invalid or missing request body fields

requestBody.description: Music composition parameters with optional timestamps

200.description: Audio and metadata generated successfully. Response is multipart/mixed: JSON metadata followed by binary audio.

400.description: Validation failed — invalid or missing request body fields

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

song-id.description: Unique identifier for the generated song

post.description: Generate background music from video files. Upload 1–10 video files via multipart/form-data (max 200 MB total). The AI analyzes the video content and generates music that matches the mood, pacing, and style. Optionally provide a text description and style tags to guide the output.

requestBody.description: Video files and optional generation parameters

files.description: Video files to analyze (max 200 MB total)

description.description: Optional text description to guide the music generation

sign_with_c2pa.description: Sign the output with C2PA content credentials

song-id.description: Unique identifier for the generated song

400.description: Validation failed — invalid or missing request body fields

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

post.description: Separate an audio file into individual stems (vocals, drums, bass, etc.). Upload an audio file via multipart/form-data. Choose between two-stem separation (vocals + instrumental) or six-stem separation (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, other). Returns a ZIP archive containing the separated stems.

file.description: Audio file to separate into stems

stem_variation_id.description: Stem separation mode. `two_stems_v1` produces vocals + instrumental. `six_stems_v1` produces vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, and other.

sign_with_c2pa.description: Sign the output with C2PA content credentials

200.description: Stems separated successfully. Returns a ZIP archive containing the individual stems.

400.description: Validation failed — invalid or missing request body fields

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

prompt.description: Music description: style, mood, vocals, instrumentation and arrangement.
prompt.example: Genre: acoustic pop. BPM: 96. Key: C major. Warm and intimate, building gently into the chorus.

lyrics.description: The lyrics to sing. Structure tags such as `[intro]`, `[verse]`, `[chorus]` and `[outro]` must each be on their own line; text on the same line as a leading tag is dropped by the model.
lyrics.example:
[verse]
Morning light filtering through the pine
[chorus]
Softly the world begins to breathe

duration.description: Upper bound on the generated audio length in seconds. The model may stop earlier; the actual length comes back as `duration_seconds`.

seed.description: Seed for reproducibility. Omit for a random seed.

num_inference_steps.description: Flow-matching steps per denoising chunk. More steps improve quality at the cost of speed.

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale of the flow-matching stage.

account_id.description: Optional. Generate on behalf of another account you can access (self, shared organization, or admin). Defaults to the calling account. Organizations are accounts, so this is also how an organization generation is scoped: send the organization's account id.

id.description: The generation's id. Poll [Get Music Generation](/api-reference/music/get) with this.

status.description: Lifecycle phase. `pending` until the workflow picks it up, `processing` while fal is rendering, then `completed` or `failed`.

prompt.description: The music description the song was generated from.

lyrics.description: The lyrics the song was generated from.

duration_seconds.description: Actual length of the generated audio. Null until completed; may be shorter than requested.

audio_url.description: Playable audio URL. Null until the generation completes.

error_message.description: Why the generation failed. Null unless `status` is `failed`.

MusicGenerationLogEntry.description: One line of the model's render progress.

seed.description: The seed the model actually used, read live from the provider rather than stored. Null until the generation completes, and null if the provider cannot be reached. Pass it back as `seed` to reproduce a generation. It is the only generation parameter recoverable after the fact: `num_inference_steps` and `guidance_scale` are consumed when the request is submitted and are never reported back.

logs.description: The model's own render progress, oldest first, read live from the provider rather than stored. Empty if the provider cannot be reached. Returned only on the single-generation read.

MusicGenerationCreateResponse.description: The accepted generation. Poll it until `status` is terminal.

generations.description: Generations, newest first. Empty when the context has none.

missing_fields.description: JSON path segments to the first field that failed validation, e.g. `["lyrics"]`

ArweaveTransaction.description: Arweave transaction object for the stored image

id.description: Unique identifier for the Arweave transaction

data.description: Transaction data (may be empty in response)

video_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the video to analyze. Supported formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, and other FFmpeg-compatible formats. Maximum duration: 1 hour.

prompt.description: A text prompt that guides the analysis. Can be instructive, descriptive, or phrased as a question. Examples: "Describe the key moments in this video", "Generate 5 SEO keywords for this video".

temperature.description: Controls the randomness of the text output. Lower values produce more focused results. Defaults to `0.2`.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. If omitted, uses the model default.

text.description: The generated analysis text based on the video and prompt.

finish_reason.description: `stop` if the generation completed normally. `length` if truncated at the token limit.

output_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the generated text.

language.description: Language code for transcription (e.g. en, es, fr). Defaults to en.

chunk_level.description: Granularity of timestamp chunks. Defaults to word-level.

diarize.description: Enable speaker diarization. Defaults to false.

model.description: fal.ai model ID. Defaults to fal-ai/whisper

fullLyrics.description: Complete transcribed lyrics as a single string

ContentCreateEditRequest.description: Requires a video URL. Operations are applied sequentially via ffmpeg.

template.description: Template name for deterministic edit config. If provided, operations are read from the template. See [GET /api/content/templates](/api-reference/content/templates) for available options.

operations.description: Array of edit operations to apply in order. Required if template is not provided.

runId.description: Background task run ID. Poll via [GET /api/tasks/runs](/api-reference/tasks/runs) to check progress.

ContentCreateErrorResponse.description: Returned when the artist is missing required files or the template is not found. Includes actionable instructions for resolving each issue.

error.example: Artist 'new-artist' is not ready for content creation

ready.description: Always `false` when this error is returned

missing.description: List of missing files with severity and fix instructions. Only present when the artist fails validation.

available_templates.description: List of valid template names. Only present when the requested template was not found.

prompt.description: Text prompt used to generate or edit the image

image_urls.description: Reference images to edit (1-10 HTTP(S) URLs). When provided, edits these images with `prompt` instead of generating a new one.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. If omitted, the model chooses automatically based on the request.

sync_mode.description: If true, the image is returned as a data URI and is not persisted in the request history

imageUrl.description: URL of the first generated image

images.description: URLs of all generated images. Contains one element when num_images is 1.

ContentCreateRequest.description: Parameters for triggering the content creation pipeline.

artist_account_id.description: UUID of the artist account to create content for. Use [GET /api/artists](/api-reference/artists/list) to find artist account IDs.

template.description: Optional template ID for content generation. Defines the visual style, scene, and prompt configuration. When omitted, the pipeline runs in malleable mode using only the params you provide. See GET /api/content/templates for available options.

lipsync.description: Whether to generate video with lip-synced audio. When `true`, uses an audio-to-video model that bakes audio into the video for lip movement. When `false`, generates video from the image alone and overlays audio in post. If omitted, the template's default workflow is used.

caption_length.description: Controls the length of the generated caption text. `none` skips caption generation. `short` produces 1-2 lines (punchy, minimal). `medium` produces 1-2 sentences. `long` produces a paragraph (stream of consciousness style). Defaults to `none`.

upscale.description: Whether to upscale the generated image and video for higher resolution and detail. Adds approximately 2 minutes to the pipeline. Defaults to `false`.

batch.description: Number of videos to generate in parallel. Each video independently selects a random reference image, song clip, and mood variation. The response always returns `runIds` as an array. Defaults to `1`.

songs.description: Optional list of song slugs or public URLs to use for the audio track. Song slugs match filenames without extension from the artist's `songs/` directory (e.g. `"hiccups"` for `hiccups.mp3`). Public URLs (e.g. `"https://example.com/my-song.mp3"`) are downloaded, transcribed, and clipped directly — bypassing the Git repo. When omitted, all songs in the artist's repo are eligible.

images.description: Optional list of public image URLs to use as face guides instead of the artist's default `face-guide.png` from their GitHub repo. The first image is used as the primary face guide. Useful when the caller wants to override the default face reference.

ContentCreateResponse.description: Confirmation that the content creation pipeline has been triggered. Always returns `runIds` as an array — even for a single run, it contains one element.

runIds.description: Array of run IDs. Poll each via [GET /api/tasks/runs](/api-reference/tasks/runs). For single runs this contains one element.

status.description: Indicates the pipeline has been triggered

artist_account_id.description: UUID of the artist account the pipeline is running for

template.description: Template ID when a preset pipeline is used; null in malleable mode.

failed.description: Number of triggers that failed. Only present when some triggers failed.

template.description: Optional template ID. When provided, injects the template's caption guide (tone, rules, formats) and examples into the LLM prompt. Caller's topic is still required. See [GET /api/content/templates](/api-reference/content/templates) for available options.

topic.description: The subject or theme for caption generation

font.description: Font name for the text, or null for default

color.description: Text color as a CSS color value

borderColor.description: Text border/stroke color as a CSS color value

url.description: URL of the image or video to upscale

type.description: Whether the input is an image or video

target_resolution.description: Target output resolution. When provided, overrides upscale_factor with a resolution-based upscale.

url.description: URL of the upscaled image or video

prompt_expansion_mode.description: How much effort to spend rewriting the prompt before generation. `balanced` returns in about a second. `quality` spends up to ~30s on a richer prompt.

image_url.description: URL of the image to use as the first frame. When provided, the output aspect ratio follows this image. Generate an image first via POST /api/content/image if needed.

end_image_url.description: Optional URL of the image to use as the last frame, for first-to-last keyframe generation

duration.description: Duration of the generated video, in seconds

resolution.description: The native generation resolution of the video

seed.description: Random seed. A random seed is selected when omitted.

enable_safety_checker.description: If true, the safety checker will be enabled

sync_mode.description: Return the generated video as base64 instead of a CDN URL

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong

ContentEstimateComparison.description: Summary comparing the cheapest and most expensive workflow options.

cheapest.description: Name of the cheapest workflow profile

cheapestPerVideo.description: Cost per video for the cheapest workflow

mostExpensive.description: Name of the most expensive workflow profile

mostExpensivePerVideo.description: Cost per video for the most expensive workflow

savingsPercent.description: Percentage savings between the cheapest and most expensive workflows

ContentEstimateResponse.description: Cost estimates based on current pricing. When `compare` is `false`, the `workflows` array contains a single entry. When `true`, it contains all available profiles.

workflows.description: One or more workflow cost breakdowns

comparison.description: Side-by-side summary. Only present when `compare` is `true` and multiple workflows are returned.

batch.description: Batch cost projection. Only present when `batch` > 1.

count.description: Number of videos in the batch

cheapestTotal.description: Total cost for the batch using the cheapest workflow

mostExpensiveTotal.description: Total cost for the batch using the most expensive workflow

ContentMissingFile.description: A missing file that prevents or degrades content creation.

file.description: Relative path of the missing file within the artist directory

severity.description: `required` means the pipeline will fail without this file. `recommended` means the pipeline will run but output quality is degraded.

description.description: What this file is used for in the pipeline
description.example: Face guide image used for AI image generation

fix.description: Actionable instructions for creating or adding the missing file
fix.example: Generate a face guide using fal-ai/nano-banana-pro/edit with 2-3 reference photos of the artist

ContentStepEstimate.description: Cost details for a single pipeline step.

model.description: The AI model or service used for this step

cost.description: Estimated cost for this step in USD

unit.description: Billing unit type (e.g., `images`, `seconds`, `megapixels`). Not present for free steps.

unitPrice.description: Price per billing unit in USD. Not present for free steps.

ContentTemplate.description: A content creation template — a complete creative recipe defining visual style, composition, caption rules, and edit operations. Templates are optional; all primitives work without one.

id.description: Template identifier. Pass this as the template field in content primitive requests or POST /api/content/create.

description.description: Human-readable description of the template's visual style
description.example: Moody bedroom selfie. Artist on camera with deadpan expression, purple LED lighting, dark room. Short blunt captions in lowercase. Vertical 9:16 video, 8 seconds. Best for: introspective songs, vulnerable moments, daily content. Requires: face image, audio.

ContentTemplateDetail.description: Full configuration for a content creation template including image prompts, video motion config, caption style rules, and edit operations.

description.example: Moody bedroom selfie. Artist on camera with deadpan expression, purple LED lighting, dark room.

prompt.description: Default image prompt used when no caller prompt is provided

reference_images.description: Reference image URLs for style conditioning

moods.description: Mood descriptors for motion prompt generation

operations.description: Default edit operations applied during post-processing

CreateSandboxRequest.description: Request body for creating a new sandbox. All fields are optional - if no command or prompt is provided, sandbox is created without triggering a command execution task. Use prompt as a shortcut to run OpenCode with a given prompt instead of specifying command/args manually.

command.description: The command to execute in the sandbox environment. If omitted, the sandbox is created without running any command.

args.description: Optional arguments to pass to the command.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for command execution.

prompt.description: A prompt to pass to OpenCode in the sandbox. When provided, the sandbox will execute `opencode run "<prompt>"`. Cannot be used together with command.

account_id.description: UUID of the account to create the sandbox for. Only applicable when the authenticated account has access to multiple accounts via organization membership. If not provided, creates the sandbox for the API key's own account.

UUID of the account to delete the sandbox for. Only applicable when the authenticated account has access to multiple accounts via organization membership. If not provided, deletes the sandbox for the API key's own account.

deleted_snapshot.description: The snapshot record that was deleted. Null if no snapshot existed for the account.

error.description: Error message (only present if status is error)

FileTreeEntry.description: A single entry in a GitHub repository file tree

path.description: The file or directory path relative to the repository root

type.description: The type of entry: blob for files, tree for directories

sha.description: The SHA hash of the entry

size.description: The size of the file in bytes. Only present for blob entries.
